# Rhino Rally: Ghired Populate

**Commander:** Ghired, Conclave Exile (Red / Green / White)
**Bracket:** 2 (Core)

## What the deck does
Ghired arrives with a 4/4 trampling Rhino. Every time he attacks, he **populates**: you create a copy of any creature token you control, already tapped and attacking. This deck gives Ghired the best tokens to copy and as many extra populate effects as possible, so your herd grows every single turn.

## Game plan
1. **Turns 1-4: Ramp.** Sol Ring, Signets, Llanowar Elves, Rampant Growth, Farseek and Cultivate set up an early Ghired.
2. **Turns 4-6: Start the herd.** Ghired, Rampaging Baloths, Growing Ranks and Trostani, Selesnya's Voice make tokens and copies.
3. **Turns 6+: Refill and finish.** Garruk's Packleader, Elemental Bond and Idol of Oblivion draw off every big token. Intangible Virtue, Shared Animosity, Beastmaster Ascension and Mirror Entity turn the board into lethal damage.

## Key synergies
- **Permanent copies of temporary tokens:** Mimic Vat, Feldon of the Third Path, Flamerush Rider and Hate Mirage make tokens that leave at end of turn. Populate them and the copies stay.
- **One-sided wipes:** Hour of Reckoning kills only nontoken creatures. Phyrexian Rebirth leaves you a giant Horror token to copy.
- **Doubling turns:** Second Harvest and Song of the Worldsoul can double a board in one go.
- **Sculpture trick:** Doomed Artisan's Sculptures can't attack, but a populated copy enters attacking anyway.

## Mulligan
Keep 3-5 lands with a ramp piece and a way to reach all three colours. Mulligan one-landers and hands full of six-drops.

## Play tips
- Populate your **best** token, not your newest.
- Each populated token can attack a different opponent.
- Hold Rootborn Defenses or Boros Charm against open mana.
- Cast Wingmate Roc after Ghired has attacked to trigger raid.

## Interaction
Swords to Plowshares, Lightning Bolt, Beast Within, Generous Gift, Chaos Warp, Angel of Sanctions, Trostani's Judgment, Naya Charm, Sundering Growth and Selesnya Eulogist cover creatures, artifacts, enchantments and graveyards.

## Upgrades
Anointed Procession, Parallel Lives, Trostani Discordant, March of the Multitudes, Selesnya Charm.

# The One-Winged Reaper

*Sephiroth, Planet's Heir — Blue/Black removal control, Bracket 2*

## The idea
Sephiroth punishes opponents for having creatures. When he enters, everything they control gets **-2/-2**, and every opposing creature that dies adds a **+1/+1 counter** to him. This deck is packed with removal so he keeps growing, then swings with **vigilance** to stay home as a blocker.

## Game plan
1. **Turns 1–4:** Ramp with Sol Ring, Arcane Signet, Dimir Signet, Talisman of Dominance and Mind Stone. Answer early threats with Infernal Grasp, Feed the Swarm and Dead Weight.
2. **Turn 5ish:** Cast Sephiroth when his -2/-2 clears tokens and small creatures. Follow with Deadly Embrace to draw a pile of cards.
3. **Late game:** Keep the board clear with Overkill, Sephiroth's Intervention and Archfiend of Depravity. Ultimecia taps blockers, and Syr Konrad and Blood Artist drain players out.

## Key cards
- **Deadly Embrace** — removal that draws for every creature that died this turn.
- **Crippling Fear** — name Human; your key creatures survive.
- **Massacre Girl** — a chain-reaction wipe that can trigger Sephiroth again and again.
- **Evil Reawakened / Zombify** — bring Sephiroth or a big creature back.

## Mulligan
Keep two to four lands with ramp and a removal spell. Sephiroth costs six, so prioritise mana.

## Tips
- Count enemy creatures with two or less toughness before casting Sephiroth.
- Cycle **Decree of Pain** for a cheap one-sided -2/-2.
- Hold **Negate** or **Counterspell** for sweepers once he is huge.

## Upgrades
Massacre Wurm, Black Sun's Zenith, Grave Pact, Cavalier of Night.

# Twice the Swarm

*Adrix and Nev, Twincasters - Simic tokens, Bracket 2*

## The Commander
Adrix and Nev double every token you make. One Insect becomes two, four becomes eight. Ward 2 makes them a little harder to remove.

## How It Plays
1. **Ramp (turns 1-3):** Sol Ring, Signets, Rampant Growth, Farseek, Cultivate, Kodama's Reach.
2. **Land the twins (turns 3-4):** protect them with Guardian Augmenter or Shore Up.
3. **Go wide:** Hornet Queen, Esika's Chariot, Garruk, Primal Hunter, Rampaging Baloths, Kazandu Tuskcaller, Imperious Perfect.
4. **Go big:** Master Biomancer, Kalonian Hydra, Flux Channeler, Paradox Zone and the Fractal makers.
5. **Finish:** Overrun, Beastmaster Ascension, Biomass Mutation or Return of the Wildspeaker.

## Key Cards
- **Rite of Replication** - kicked, it makes ten copies.
- **Esix, Fractal Bloom** - turns your first tokens each turn into copies of a real creature.
- **Second Harvest** - copies every token, then the twins double the copies.
- **Reef Worm** - two Fish, four Whales, eight Krakens.

## Card Flow
Idol of Oblivion, Shamanic Revelation, Golden Ratio, Primal Empathy and Return of the Wildspeaker keep your hand full.

## Interaction
- **Spot removal:** Beast Within, Rapid Hybridization, Resculpt, Reality Shift, Krosan Grip, Counterspell, Acidic Slime.
- **Mass removal:** Curse of the Swine and Ezuri's Predation.
- **Board reset:** Oversimplify.

## Mulligan
Keep three or four lands with ramp and both colours. Ship two-landers full of six-drops.

## Tips
- Cast the twins first, then the token spells.
- Crafty Cutpurse steals the tokens your own removal gives away.
- Count your power before the big swing.

## Upgrades
Parallel Lives, Avenger of Zendikar, Heroic Intervention, Song of the Dryads.

# Plain Vanilla Stampede

**Commander:** Ruxa, Patient Professor

## The idea
Most decks want creatures with lots of text. This one wants creatures with **none**. Ruxa gives every creature with no abilities +1/+1. It also lets each of them deal its combat damage to the player as though it weren't blocked. Plain beasts suddenly hit hard and can't be chump blocked.

## How it plays
1. **Ramp early** with Llanowar Elves, Elvish Mystic, Sol Ring, Rampant Growth and Cultivate.
2. **Land Ruxa** on turn three or four.
3. **Flood the board** with vanillas like Garruk's Gorehorn, Vorstclaw, Swordwise Centaur and Rumbling Baloth.
4. **Refill** with Hunter's Insight, Colossal Majesty, Garruk's Packleader and Elemental Bond.
5. **Finish** with Gaea's Anthem, Unnatural Growth or Return of the Wildspeaker.

## Rules notes
- Counters and plain stat boosts are not abilities. Oran-Rief, the Vastwood, Heraldic Banner and Blackblade Reforged keep your vanillas vanilla.
- Effects that say a creature *has* or *gains* something do turn off Ruxa's bonus. Swiftfoot Boots, Lightning Greaves, Snakeskin Veil and Blossoming Defense are for Ruxa.
- Tokens from Rampaging Baloths, Sandwurm Convergence, Garruk, Primal Hunter, Esika's Chariot, Paradox Zone, Khalni Garden and Ezuri's Predation have no abilities, so Ruxa pumps them.

## Interaction
Beast Within, Prizefight, Primal Might, Bite Down, Ram Through, Voracious Hydra, Khalni Ambush, Inscription of Abundance, Acidic Slime, Return to Nature and Broken Wings handle threats. Nevinyrral's Disk is the emergency reset.

## Mulligan
Keep 3-4 lands, or 2 lands plus ramp, with a couple of early creatures.

## Upgrades
Leatherback Baloth, Ancient Brontodon, Grizzly Bears and Bear Cub add even more vanilla goodness.

# Curtain Call Carnage

**Commander:** Juri, Master of the Revue

## What the deck does
Juri gets a +1/+1 counter whenever you sacrifice a permanent. That includes creatures, Treasures, mana rocks and lands. When Juri dies, it deals damage equal to its power to any target. This deck sacrifices things all game long, grows Juri, and then either swings with it or throws it at someone.

## How to win
- **Fling it.** Fling or Kazuul's Fury // Kazuul's Cliffs deals Juri's power, then Juri's death trigger deals that much again. Add Unleash Fury or Blackblade Reforged first, and copy the Fling with Reverberate for a huge turn.
- **Drain them.** Blood Artist, Vengeful Bloodwitch, Falkenrath Noble and Bastion of Remembrance punish the table every time something dies. Starscape Cleric adds extra life loss whenever you gain life, and Underworld Dreams pings opponents as they draw.
- **Just attack.** A Juri with a stack of counters plus Rogue's Passage or Swiftfoot Boots ends games.

## Early game
Play Juri on turn two, then cheap fodder: Reassembling Skeleton, Persistent Specimen, Impulsive Pilferer. Get an outlet out: Viscera Seer, Vampiric Rites, High Market or Fain, the Broker.

## Midgame
Use Village Rites, Deadly Dispute, Nasty End, Costly Plunder and Altar's Reap to trade bodies for cards. Midnight Reaper keeps you drawing. Mahadi, Emporium Master and Rain of Riches make Treasures to sacrifice, and Lively Dirge refills your board from the graveyard.

## Interaction
Targeted removal: Eaten Alive, Bone Splinters, Bone Shards, Feed the Swarm, Terminate, Infernal Grasp, Go for the Throat, Dismember, Tragic Slip, Abrade. Board wipes: Blasphemous Act, Blood Money, Fiery Confluence. Edicts: Fleshbag Marauder, Accursed Marauder, Plaguecrafter, Fatal Grudge.

## Tips
- Sacrifice Juri in response to exile or bounce so the death trigger still fires.
- Supernatural Stamina and Undying Malice let Juri die, deal its damage and come back.
- Self-sacrificing lands like Evolving Wilds and Myriad Landscape are free Juri counters.

## Upgrades
Mayhem Devil, Woe Strider, Claim the Firstborn, Judith, the Scourge Diva.

# Death and Dividends

*Commander: Mahadi, Emporium Master*

## Overview
Mahadi gives you a Treasure at your end step for **every creature that died this turn**, no matter whose it was. This deck makes sure plenty of creatures die every turn, then spends the Treasures on more cards, more removal and bigger plays, while a ring of drain creatures bleeds the table.

## How the deck wins
- **Fodder:** Impulsive Pilferer, Reassembling Skeleton, Bloodghast, Dragon Fodder, Loyal Apprentice and Chandra, Acolyte of Flame keep bodies coming.
- **Edicts:** Fleshbag Marauder, Plaguecrafter, Demon's Disciple and Accursed Marauder make everyone sacrifice, and Mahadi counts all of them.
- **Outlets and draw:** Viscera Seer, Vampiric Rites, Village Rites, Deadly Dispute, Costly Plunder and Eviscerator's Insight turn deaths into cards.
- **Payoffs:** Blood Artist, Zulaport Cutthroat, Bastion of Remembrance, Marionette Apprentice, Syr Konrad, the Grim and Butcher of Malakir finish the job.

## Key synergies
- Treasures are artifacts and tokens, so Nadier's Nightblade and Marionette Apprentice drain when you spend them.
- Crime Novelist, Juri, Master of the Revue and Oni-Cult Anvil reward every Treasure you crack.
- Pitiless Plunderer pays instantly and Mahadi pays again at end step.
- Starscape Cleric turns all the lifegain from drain creatures into extra damage.

## Mulligan
Keep three or four lands with a cheap creature, mana rock or sacrifice outlet. Avoid hands that are all payoffs and nothing to sacrifice.

## Play tips
1. Cast edict creatures on your own turn after Mahadi is out.
2. Order Mahadi's end step trigger below Chandra's Elemental sacrifice so they count.
3. Hold end-step Treasures for instant-speed removal.
4. Blasphemous Act and Blood Money with drainers out can end a stalled game; count life totals first.

## Upgrades
- Mayhem Devil
- Grim Hireling
- Dictate of Erebos
- Cruel Celebrant

## Bracket
Built for Bracket 2: no Game Changers, no land destruction, no extra turns and no two-card infinite loops. Wins come from creatures and enchantments everyone can see and answer.

page.primer_md:
# Krenko's Endless Mob

## The Commander
**Krenko, Mob Boss** taps to create a 1/1 goblin for every goblin you control, including himself. Each activation roughly doubles your army.

## Game Plan
1. **Early:** build a small goblin crew with Dragon Fodder, Krenko's Command and Beetleback Chief, and ramp with Sol Ring, Arcane Signet or Fire Diamond.
2. **Mid:** cast Krenko with haste from Goblin Warchief, Goblin Chieftain, Lightning Greaves or Swiftfoot Boots and start doubling.
3. **Late:** Impact Tremors, Raid Bombardment and Goblin Bombardment chip opponents down; Shared Animosity, Trumpet Blast or Burn Bright end the game.

## Interaction
Lightning Bolt, Shock, Abrade, Goblin Grenade, Outnumber and Chaos Warp handle threats. Blasphemous Act and Fiery Confluence reset the board when needed.

## Mulligan
Keep 2 to 4 lands with early plays or ramp. A haste source is a bonus.

## Tips
- Make tokens before you tap Krenko.
- Protect Krenko first, then go wide.
- Hold Trumpet Blast for the lethal swing.

## Upgrades
Goblin Instigator, Legion Warboss, Goblin Matron, Skirk Prospector, Purphoros, God of the Forge.

page.primer_md:
# Tails' Sky Garage

**Commander:** Miles "Tails" Prower (White/Blue)

## The Idea
Tails turns every Vehicle into an air force. When a Vehicle enters, you **draw a card** if it flies. If it doesn't fly, it gets a **flying counter**. Build a garage, crew it up and fly over everyone.

## How the Deck Wins
1. **Turns 1-3:** Play rocks like Sol Ring and Arcane Signet, cheap Vehicles like Smuggler's Copter and Sky Skiff, and crew members.
2. **Turns 4-6:** Land Tails (ideally with flash at an opponent's end step), then add Vehicles. Kotori, Pilot Prodigy gives every Vehicle crew 2. Sram, Senior Edificer and Tails keep cards flowing.
3. **Late game:** The Prydwen, Steel Flagship, Brotherhood Vertibird and a sky full of flying-countered Vehicles close the game.

## Key Cards
- **Smuggler's Copter:** cheap flyer that loots.
- **Peacewalker Colossus:** animates other Vehicles without crew.
- **Surgehacker Mech:** removal that gets stronger with each Vehicle you control.
- **Sculpting Steel / Ghostly Flicker / Sun Titan:** extra Tails triggers.

## Sweepers Are Your Friend
Supreme Verdict, Austere Command and Time Wipe destroy creatures. An uncrewed Vehicle is just an artifact, so your fleet survives. Time Wipe even returns Tails to your hand first.

## Removal and Protection
Swords to Plowshares, Get Lost, Dispatch and Banishing Light handle threats. Lightning Greaves, Swiftfoot Boots and Padeem, Consul of Innovation keep your engine running.

## Upgrades
Shorikai, Genesis Engine, Skysovereign, Consul Flagship, Reckoner Bankbuster, Weatherlight and Mech Hangar.

# Light and Shadow Legends

**Commander:** Ardbert, Warrior of Darkness

## What the deck does
Every white or black spell you cast puts a +1/+1 counter on **each legendary creature** you control. This deck is packed with cheap legends and cheap spells, so the whole team grows every turn.

## Key synergies
- **Double triggers:** white-and-black spells like *Mortify*, *Utter End*, *Anguished Unmaking*, *Vanishing Verse* and *Despark* trigger both abilities: two counters, vigilance **and** menace.
- **Anthems:** *Arvad the Cursed*, *Day of Destiny* and *Heroes' Podium* make a wide board of legends huge.
- **Value engines:** *Venat, Heart of Hydaelyn*, *Lord Jyscal Guado* and *Teysa, Opulent Oligarch* keep the cards coming.
- **Lifegain:** *Soul's Attendant* and lifelink legends feed *Haliya, Guided by Light* and *Starscape Cleric*.
- **One-sided reset:** *Urza's Ruinous Blast* exiles everything that isn't legendary.
- **Rebuild:** *Primevals' Glorious Rebirth* returns your legends after a wipe.

## Mulligan
Keep 2-4 lands plus a cheap legend or mana rock. Ship one-landers and hands with no early plays.

## Tips
1. Colourless rocks like *Sol Ring* do not trigger Ardbert.
2. Cast a black spell before combat for menace, a white one for vigilance.
3. Ardbert's triggers resolve even if your spell is countered.
4. Protect your best legend with *Swiftfoot Boots*, *Champion's Helm* or *Restoration Magic*.
